text:
elaine: Quick flag from a customer on private deployment (client-zeta): they observed missing audit entries for key unwraps during a controlled pen test. stack traces show success but SIEM shows gaps. anyone seen this pattern?
peter: saw something similar but that was netpol sidecar blocking outbound to our logging-gateway. did they enable stricter egress rules recently?
mina: client-zeta applied the "deny-all-egress" baseline last week per compliance checklist. they allowed only internal service mesh. our logging-gateway sits outside the mesh (10.200.5.8:5044) so that would match.
ops-bot: config-change: client-zeta/netpol updated by ops-user@client at 2025-03-04T14:02Z -> baseline/deny-egress v2
elaine: Ok that explains network-level drop. But two followups: (1) why didn't the proxy emit a local audit backup (we have optional local-file fallback), and (2) why didn't our healthcheck alert trigger for missing audit-forwarding?
ryan: Checking proxy config: in private deployments we run audit-forwarder -> fluentd sidecar -> external-gateway. The fallback to local-file is gated by an egress-check probe. If egress probe fails, we intentionally pause local-file to avoid filling disk in runaway situations.
peter: That gating seems risky for on-prem customers with intentional egress block. Should be inverted: write local-file first, then attempt forward.
mina: Agreed. Also client-zeta opted into "strict-dataplane" which disables local-disk by default for air-gap reasons. they didn't request audit-externalization so we assumed forwarding was required.
elaine: We need a reproducible test matrix: combinations of (strict-dataplane on/off) x (deny-egress true/false) x (local-fallback enabled/disabled) to verify we always preserve audit data somewhere.
mina: Patch idea: make local-file fallback configurable per deployment profile with explicit opt-out. default to on for private installs unless customer signs the air-gap waiver. will open PR.
ops-bot: ticket created INFRA-9721 by mina
elaine: About the alerting: our decrypt:audit_forward_ratio metric only counts successful forwards vs attempts. If attempts=0 we don't alert. For deny-egress scenarios attempts=0 so silent. need a separate probe that measures expected-forward-attempts based on deployment profile.
ryan: proposed metric: audit_expectation_mismatch = expected_forward_attempts - actual_forward_attempts. alert when > 0 for 2m. simple and avoids false positives.
peter: For immediate mitigation with client-zeta: (A) add temporary egress exception to 10.200.5.8:5044 for the window while we patch, or (B) enable local-file fallback on their deployment and rsync files to our SIEM puller over an approved channel. which does client prefer?
mina: Client prefers option B (they want to keep deny-egress) but need a secure rsync plan. We'll propose a small agent that polls an SFTP server over a mTLS tunnel initiated from customer to our ingestion collector (pull model).
elaine: Security checklist for that plan: mTLS client cert rotation policy, minimal scope SFTP account, data-in-transit encryption verification, and audit of rsync client code. add to ticket.
ops-bot: sec-review requested by mina -> SR-2025-145 (awaiting sec-team assignment)
ryan: Also found a subtle RBAC issue: service account used to write local audit files (fs-audit-writer) had its write permission revoked in a housekeeping change last month. if we re-enable fallback but the SA can't write to the mounted volume, fallback will silently fail.
peter: Oof. so multiple layers: netpol denies egress, local-disk disabled by profile, and SA missing FS write role. output could be lost end-to-end.
elaine: Action items: 1) Mina to open patch PR to make local-fallback opt-out and default-on (PR #4289). 2) Mina to propose rsync SFTP agent design and submit for SR-2025-145. 3) Ryan to re-add fs-audit-writer permission in a hotfix and validate volume write in staging. 4) Peter to author the expectation-mismatch alert rule and a short runbook. 5) Ops to offer client-zeta immediate rsync option.
mina: I'll take 1 and 2, aiming to have PR + design doc by EOD.
ryan: I'll queue the hotfix and smoke-test in staging. will post logs here once done.
ops-bot: hotfix-deploy planned -> hotfix/keystore-audit-restore at 2025-03-04T15:30Z
elaine: Filing incident INC-2025-039 to track customer impact and remediation notes. link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-039
elaine: Postmortem note: need a policy gate in infra PRs that changes SA or network baseline for private deployments to trigger a security-review checklist. can't have silent removal of audit paths.
mina: Agree. Also propose a small integration test in our acceptance harness: spin up a private deploy with deny-egress true and ensure audit files are present locally and rsync-able.
peter: :thumbsup: I'll draft the runbook steps for on-call for the audit-gap scenario. keep it lightweight.
elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30min follow-up after hotfix to validate with client.
